name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for siding stripping and replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for siding stripping and replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for siding stripping and replacement, prioritize experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Look for contractors with a strong local reputation, positive customer reviews, and a portfolio of completed projects. Request detailed estimates, clear contracts, and inquire about their warranty policies. A reputable contractor, like City Dweller, LLC, will communicate transparently, explain the process thoroughly, and adhere to safety standards, ensuring a high-quality outcome for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, proper licensing, insurance, and good local reputation. Look for clear estimates, contracts, warranty information, and transparent communication.
